paper.scope: Steady one-dimensional boundary-layer adaptation of nonnegative trainable residual masks and min-max updates. Hard endpoint ansatz,all mask lambdas initially1,Adam descent/ascent,no L-BFGS or GP interpolation. Not original Burgers/Helmholtz/Allen-Cahn benchmarks.

sources.name: McClenny & Braga-Neto (2020 preprint),Self-Adaptive Physics-Informed Neural Networks using a Soft Attention Mechanism
sources.text: Primary method:trainable nonnegative pointwise masks,neural-weight descent and adaptive-weight ascent. The original benchmarks use Adam,optionally followed by L-BFGS with masks frozen. This compact steady boundary-layer adaptation uses hard endpoints,unit initial masks and no GP or L-BFGS phase.

sources.name: Twelve CPU attention controls plus a labelled extra-budget diagnostic
sources.text: Same97-parameter network and three paired initialisations. Fixed16,shared16,point16 and fixed64;2000 updates each. Independent1001-point fields and997 held-out residual points. Separate fixed64 seed11 diagnostic uses8000updates. All final outcomes retained.
